posts.text: I along with 2 fellow friends visited their Rabale factory last month and I met them again at Semicon event at Delhi. The work they are doing is real and everything cited above is real with no froth. If things go as planned for their Goa expansion - the business wilol do significantly well. Only thing I disagree with Management is timeframe of Goa facility going live. They are claiming that Goa facility will start contributing revenue in a year or so, but I thing it will take 1.5 to 2 years for the factory to be ready.
